classifications.rationale: derived from internal class LGT.LMP.GEN via the mapping declared in the schema, not independently classified

attributes.name: Product Series
attributes.description: Manufacturer's series or family designation only, without the word "series" and without the manufacturer name. The anchor for part-number grammar induction, because the positional encoding of a smart part number is defined per series rather than per manufacturer.

attributes.name: Form
attributes.description: What kind of fitting this is, for a luminaire rather than a replaceable lamp. A chandelier and a troffer share every electrical attribute and are not remotely the same purchase, so the form is the first thing that distinguishes them.

allowed_values.note: a replaceable lamp rather than a fitting; the shape and base attributes apply

attributes.name: Lamp Technology
attributes.description: The light-producing mechanism. Determines efficacy, dimming behaviour, warm-up time and disposal obligation, so it is the first thing a specifier looks at and the attribute most reliably present in an abbreviated description.

attributes.name: Wattage
attributes.description: Nominal power the lamp or luminaire consumes at its rated voltage. For a retrofit LED this is the actual draw, not the incandescent wattage it replaces — suppliers print both and the equivalence figure is marketing, not a specification.

attributes.name: Color Temperature
attributes.description: Correlated colour temperature of the emitted light, in kelvin. Lower is warmer: 2700 K is domestic warm white, 4000 K neutral, 6500 K daylight. See this file's header for why the supplier shorthand "27k" is not expanded automatically.

attributes.name: Lumen Output
attributes.description: Initial luminous flux in lumens. The figure a lamp is actually chosen on — wattage is a cost, lumens are the product. Declared as an integer rather than a quantity because the unit registry has no luminous-flux kind, so there is no lumen unit to convert to or from and a quantity would fail schema load. The consequence is a blank UOM cell in the delivery grid.

attributes.name: Voltage Rating
attributes.description: Nominal supply voltage the appliance is designed to operate on. Read the nameplate or electrical-specification row, not the motor or component rating, which may differ.

attributes.name: Voltage Range
attributes.description: Supply voltage window the product operates across, for universal-input drivers stated as a span rather than a single figure. Distinct from voltage_rating, which is a single nominal value; a 120-277 V driver genuinely has no single nominal voltage.

attributes.name: Lamp Shape
attributes.description: ANSI/IEC envelope designation. The letter names the profile and the number is the maximum diameter in eighths of an inch, so A19 is a 2-3/8" A-shape and T12 a 1-1/2" tube. Governs whether the lamp physically fits the fixture and, for reflector shapes, how it throws light.

attributes.name: Base Type
attributes.description: The cap that engages the socket. An exact match is required for the product to function at all, which makes this the one lighting attribute where a difference is disqualifying rather than merely consequential.

allowed_values.note: LED array not replaceable; the luminaire is the lamp

attributes.name: Beam Angle
attributes.description: Angle of the cone within which intensity stays above half its peak. Applies to directional lamps such as MR16, PAR and BR shapes; an omnidirectional A-shape lamp has none, and recording one for it is an error rather than a default.

attributes.name: Color Rendering Index
attributes.description: CRI, the fidelity with which the source renders colour against a reference, on a 0-100 scale. Dimensionless by definition, so no unit is declared. Retail and gallery lighting specifies 90+; a high-pressure sodium street lamp sits near 25.

attributes.name: Rated Life
attributes.description: Hours at which the stated proportion of a population is expected to have failed, or for LED to have depreciated to a stated fraction of initial output. The threshold differs by technology and manufacturer, so the figure is only comparable within a technology.

attributes.name: Dimmable
attributes.description: Whether the product is designed to dim on a compatible control. Stated explicitly or not at all: an LED lamp on an incompatible dimmer flickers or fails early, so absence of a claim is meaningful and must not be read as either value.

attributes.name: Nominal Length
attributes.description: Overall length as the manufacturer designates it, for tubes, strips and linear fixtures. A designation rather than a measurement: a nominal 4' fluorescent tube is 47-3/4" so that it fits a 4' fixture, and recording the measured figure would contradict every catalogue.

attributes.name: Pack Quantity
attributes.description: Number of units in the consumer pack the part number sells as. Distinct from case_quantity, which counts packs in a shipping carton: a "3pk" of lamps is one sellable unit containing three lamps, and confusing the two misprices the line.

attributes.name: Color
attributes.description: Finish or colourway as the manufacturer names it. A merchandising attribute: buyers filter on it heavily, and the manufacturer's own name for a finish is what shoppers search, so it is recorded verbatim rather than mapped to a generic colour.

attributes.name: Approvals and Listings
attributes.description: Third-party certifications, listings and approvals explicitly stated in the source. Record only what is stated. A listing number without a recognised mark is not an approval, and an approval for one size in a series does not extend to the others.

allowed_values.note: Generic NSF mark with no standard named. Deliberately not aliased onto NSF-61: a potable-water claim needs the specific standard, and treating this as equivalent would let a cross-field rule pass on evidence that does not support it.
eye and face protection impact rating
hand protection cut, abrasion and puncture rating
building-code evaluation report for a structural or envelope product
composite decking and railing performance standard

attributes.name: Country of Origin
attributes.description: Country where the product is manufactured, as stated by the manufacturer. Drives tariff treatment and trade-agreement eligibility, so a guess here has direct financial consequences.

attributes.name: Warranty
attributes.description: Warranty coverage as stated by the manufacturer, including duration and what it covers, e.g. "1 Year Manufacturer, 1 Year Labor and Parts". Recorded as published: summarising it into a single duration loses the parts/labour distinction that determines what a claim actually pays for.
example_values: 1 Year Manufacturer, 1 Year Labor and Parts

attributes.name: GTIN / UPC
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number, 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits. The final digit is a modulo-10 check digit, which L0 validation verifies arithmetically — a transposed digit is therefore detectable without any external lookup.

cross_field_rules.message: A beam angle was recorded. It is only meaningful for a directional envelope — PAR, BR and MR shapes — and an omnidirectional A-shape or a linear tube does not have one. Where the shape is non-directional this usually means a field angle was copied from an adjacent column. A warning rather than an error because a luminaire legitimately has a beam angle and no lamp shape at all, which is the majority of the fixture half of this class.

Lumens divided by watts exceeds 250 lm/W, which is above the demonstrated laboratory ceiling for a white LED and far above anything commercially available. Effectively always a decimal error in one of the two figures, or a lumen value read from a multi-lamp fixture's total against a single lamp's wattage. An error rather than a warning because both figures are individually plausible, so nothing else in the stack will catch it.

policy.reason: at threshold 0.719, 75.9% of values are publishable with an error rate of at most 1.6% at 95% confidence
